title: Select Mode Grabbers improperly transform Children of nodes with `size`
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.beta1

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta1 - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 580 Series (RADV POLARIS10) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 61.96 GiB memory

### Issue description

Less correct Title: Packing & Ctrl+G ignored for Children of ~~Node2D~~ Control

Two (three) methods of assuring child nodes follow the transformation of their parent node fail when their Common ancestor is CanvasItem and the Parent node has a `size` attribute regardless of whether the child does.

All methods failed to properly apply the transform to the entire subtree; and didn't give a warning or error message.

The issue appears to be that the grabbers apparently mean "modify size of node; or scale when there is no size".
Where scale affects the subtree, while size does only change a single node.
And also that the grabbers of the first selected node are not hidden **and disabled**, but only hidden; as long as the selection only includes nodes in its subtree.

### Steps to reproduce

I assembled a mock-up scene consisting of ColorRect and Sprite2D nodes, and then tried to transform the entire thing in the 2D editor.
I tried  
Ctrl+G grouping
1. Select `Magenta` in Scene Tree
2. Ctrl+G, Q
3. Click `Magenta` (lower right square) in the 2D Editor
4. Drag the orange grabber to resize the nodes
5. Observe that only `Magenta` changes size

Selecting all the Nodes
1. Select `Magenta` in Scene Tree
2. Ctrl+Shift+G, Q
3. In the Scene Tree, click `Magenta`, then Shift+Click `Blue`
4. Drag where the grabber was visible previously
5. Observe that only `Magenta` changes size

 Using a PackedScene Instance
1. Drag `MRP.tscn` into a Node2D or Control project
2. In the Inspector, change its size or minimum_size from (0, 0) to something meaningful (e.g. 128 by 128)
3. Deselect, Q, Select the instance
4. Drag by the orange grabbers
5. Observe that only the Magenta square changes size


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)


[MRP.tscn.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20885099/MRP.tscn.zip)
